exceptions.reason: zod 3.25.76 is the newest 3.x release and none is patched; the advisory's first patched version is 4.6.6. It is installed for @gitlab/gitlab-ai-provider 3.6.1 (required by @voltagent/core at ^3.1.1; its latest release still declares zod 3), @voltagent/a2a-server 2.0.3 (its latest release), autoevals 0.0.131 (pinned by @voltagent/scorers 2.1.0) and zod-from-json-schema 0.0.5, which @voltagent/core installs under the alias zod-from-json-schema-v3. Removing it needs upstream VoltAgent and GitLab provider releases; forcing zod 4 on these consumers changes their runtime contract and needs its own compatibility review. Owner-approved risk acceptance for this exact identity until 2026-12-13; this does not claim the path is unreachable or fixed.
